conflicts: CSP header intersects with Astro meta CSP (both enforced): DST vercel.json:`img-src 'self' data:` blocks the 214 `https://d1d7p8ufhgz4ld.cloudfront.net/media/…` image refs + 1 `d33wubrfki0l68.cloudfront.net` ref in posts (105 of 106 posts contain cloudfront URLs); SRC allows `img-src 'self' https: data:`.

DST astro.config.ts security.csp has only `default-src 'self'` + style; no `frame-src`: 13 YouTube, 1 diagrams.net, 2 nbviewer iframes in posts would be blocked (SRC astro.config.mjs allows youtube.com, youtube-nocookie.com, viewer.diagrams.net, nbviewer.org) and `connect-src 'self'` (search/PWA fetch).
DST scripts/built-csp.test.mjs asserts the header has NO script-src/script-src-elem/default-src and requires `frame-ancestors 'none'`; any new header directive must keep that.

`permanent: true` makes Vercel return 308, not 301 (live check: curl -I https://blogthedata.com/ -> 308; https://www.blogthedata.com/rss -> 308). John asked for 301: rules need `"statusCode": 301`; the coverage test must assert the exact code.

SRC apex rule `/(.*)` host blogthedata.com -> www catches every apex request first: per-path rules must be written so apex URLs reach the final jsolly.com URL in ONE hop (or the apex rule must be removed/ordered after).
Both repos set `trailingSlash: true`; SRC astro.config.mjs also sets `trailingSlash: 'always'` and `prerenderConflictBehavior: 'error'`; DST astro config sets neither.

DST middleware.ts runs on every GET/HEAD not matching STATIC_EXT_RE: extensionless /blog/rss/ and /blog/atom/ get Accept negotiation; a strict feed reader sending only `Accept: application/rss+xml` gets 406 (preferredType returns null); `Accept: text/markdown` on /blog/* returns the 404 Markdown body; `/recipes/.../recipe-library.md` is treated as a Markdown sibling (MARKDOWN_FILE_RE) and returns 404 Markdown. Fix: serve feeds at `.xml` paths (e.g. /blog/rss.xml) or exempt in shouldNegotiate, and exempt .md data assets.
